item.title: ‘Wolfram’ Review: Warwick Thornton Deftly Reframes Painful Indigenous Australian Experience Through the Lens of Classic Western Archetypes
item.description: Deborah Mailman is the wounded heart of this loose sequel to 2017’s ‘Sweet Country,’ set on the 1930s colonial frontier a few years after the events of the earlier film.
